description: Details required by Conditions 6 (paint removal), 7 (doors and ironmongery schedule), 8 (window storage), 9 (schedule of damp remedial works) of Listed Building consent LB/25/05238 (Alterations to the front elevation, including replacement of doors and installation of soil vent pipe; resurfacing of front paved areas; installation of rooflights and solar thermal panels; erection of two-storey rear infill extension at lower and upper ground floor levels, including reconfiguration of the lower ground lightwell; excavation and provision of basement extension below part of rear garden; alterations to the rear elevation including replacement of one door and two windows; removal of rear external boiler enclosure and associated flue attached to side of closet wing; installation of two external air conditioning condenser units within acoustic enclosures in rear garden; hard and soft landscaping to rear garden; and internal alterations, including works to front vaults)
